event.description: Remove the unused padding vocabulary vector
event.proposal: Family: token representation. Current retained frontier is 3,424 parameters at 99.180000%, a +0.180000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 2 prior attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0005, the interleaved LSB-first representation at 5,792 parameters and 99.93% official accuracy; the most recent failed result is attempt-0013, an optimization failure where removing both equals and PAD plateaued near 6.10% validation and produced no official score. Hypothesis: that failure identifies the equals delimiter as useful, while PAD is never present in any fixed-length training or inference sequence; deleting only PAD is parameterization-preserving compression that removes one tied 16D vocabulary vector, yielding 3,408 parameters without changing token streams. This is more informative than the nearest untested EOS removal because it isolates a provably unused parameter from a functional decoding symbol at the fragile width-7 frontier.
